required_properties: exact article title, responsibility, journal identity, and publication date
article-text rights separated from artifact-image and software rights
2020 corpus snapshot and all material counting parameters
Tribute case-study conclusions bounded as frontier interpretation
versioned code and data route with currentness and license state
current PCSL and Unicode comparison without false comparability
acceptable_substitutions: the publisher PDF for exact article verification
a versioned software deposit for reproducing the historical count method
a current corpus snapshot only when its inclusion and normalization parameters are explicit

channel_comparison.notes: Complete for Work identity, authorship, date, citation, and article rights. Originating journal record and exact author profiles were selected as authority; the old ToS mistitle was explicitly rejected. Stable HTML and PDF were available, while one author page temporarily required direct retrieval.

Complete section- and footnote-level direct evidence for the reported snapshot, parameters, and bounded Tribute case. The same article CC BY statement applies while artifact images remain separate; no table or body was copied.

Exact version DOI, concept DOI, tag, archive checksum, commit, and timestamps were resolved. Dependency and dataset reconstruction remain future work, and other-open plus no recognized GitHub license is insufficient for reuse. The route was not imported.

Current frequency, identity/encoding, and interpretive controls were located. PCSL live values lack fully comparable parameter metadata and its HTML occasionally returned 502; the official Unicode source is precise. Selected to expose drift, not overwrite the historical snapshot.
